name: review
description: Code-review toolkit: ten agents, read-only over the reviewed code, plus orchestration skills for the quality gate and fan-out, a pull-request change digest with an interactive view (/review:explain-change), a merge-risk rating with a demote-only flag (/review:merge-risk), a fan-out sweep workflow (/review:fanout-sweep), and CI lane commands (/review:code-review, /review:security-review) for org reusable workflows.

downstream_probe.title: Downstream probe
downstream_probe.description: run (default): /review:quality-gate downstream mode writes one probe for its safety fact in a temp directory outside the tree and runs it. report: it shows the probe without running it. report here or in a repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml (default branch) wins over run.

fanout_diversity.title: Fanout diversity
fanout_diversity.description: lens (default): /review:fanout run-everything runs one reviewer agent per concern. model: one review prompt per fan-out model tier. codex: the lens roster plus the Codex reviewer as the model panel. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml fanout_diversity wins over this option.

fanout_act_on_cap.title: Fanout act-on cap
fanout_act_on_cap.description: How many rows under each By axis heading (Spec, Standards) of a /review:fanout report are marked act on; default 2, a whole number of at least 1. The other rows stay in the report, marked no. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml fanout_act_on_cap wins over this option.

reproduce_findings.title: Reproduce findings
reproduce_findings.description: off (default): reports unchanged. label: findings at or above the floor go to a refute gate and get evidence labels; refuted ones are not acted on. require: unreproduced ones are not acted on either. Nothing runs reviewed code without your yes. The repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml wins.

reproduce_findings_floor.title: Reproduce findings floor
reproduce_findings_floor.description: The lowest tier the reproduce_findings gate checks; findings below it are labeled not-attempted. IMPORTANT (default), CRITICAL or SUGGESTION; another value is reported and every finding is checked. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml reproduce_findings_floor wins over this option.

smell_baseline.title: Design-smell baseline
smell_baseline.description: default (default): the code-reviewer agent checks the shipped design-smell baseline. off: no smell check. A repository-relative .md path: that list, or the shipped one when the file is missing or the change edits it. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml smell_baseline wins over this option.

loosened_check_verdict.title: Loosened-check verdict
loosened_check_verdict.description: fail (default): a change that loosens a check without the spec's reason is a blocking review finding. note: the finding blocks nothing. fail here or in a repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml (default branch) wins over note.

loosened_check_patterns.title: Loosened-check patterns (JSON)
loosened_check_patterns.description: Your entries for the loosened-check review criterion as a JSON list: path globs for a check's own files, or text: then a regex for changed lines. Empty (default): none. Every layer's entries apply, docs/conventions/review.yaml (default branch) included.

council_max_rounds.title: Council max rounds
council_max_rounds.description: How many review rounds /review:council runs at most; default 1, a whole number of at least 1. Above 1, /review:fanout fix runs between rounds. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml council_max_rounds wins over this option.

council_scores.title: Council scores
council_scores.description: on: the /review:council report carries a mark table by member and round; off (default): none. A repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml council_scores wins over this option.

council_members.title: Council members (JSON)
council_members.description: Your /review:council member catalog as JSON, the shape of council_members in docs/conventions/review.yaml, e.g. {"codex-adv":{"provider":"codex","brief":"adversarial"}}. Empty (default): the repository's value or three Opus members. The repository's value wins; invalid JSON is reported and ignored.

council_panel.title: Council panel (JSON)
council_panel.description: Your /review:council fallback panel as a JSON list of member ids. Empty (default): the repository's value or every catalog member. A repository's value wins; invalid JSON is reported and ignored.

council_rules.title: Council rules (JSON)
council_rules.description: Your /review:council selection rules as a JSON list, the same shape as council_rules in docs/conventions/review.yaml. Empty (default): the repository's rules or none. A repository's value wins; invalid JSON is reported and ignored.

digest_policy.title: Digest policy
digest_policy.description: When /review:explain-change offers a change digest: off, offer (the shipped default: when a trigger fires) or always (build at the ready flip). Empty (default): unset. The docs/conventions/review-digest YAML files win over this option.

digest_max_files.title: Digest max files
digest_max_files.description: The digest files trigger fires when a pull request changes more files than this; shipped default 5. Empty (default): unset. The docs/conventions/review-digest YAML files win over this option.

digest_max_changed_lines.title: Digest max changed lines
digest_max_changed_lines.description: The digest changed-lines trigger fires when additions plus deletions exceed this; shipped default 200. Empty (default): unset. The docs/conventions/review-digest YAML files win over this option.

digest_blast_radius.title: Digest blast radius (JSON)
digest_blast_radius.description: Assessed blast radius levels that fire the digest offer, as a JSON list of LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH and CRITICAL; shipped default ["HIGH","CRITICAL"]. Empty (default): unset. The docs/conventions/review-digest YAML files win over this option.

digest_risk_paths.title: Digest risk paths (JSON)
digest_risk_paths.description: Path globs that fire the digest offer when a changed path matches, as a JSON list of at most 64 globs of at most 256 characters each, e.g. ["db/migrations/*"]. Empty (default): unset. The docs/conventions/review-digest YAML files win over this option.

digest_opt_in_label.title: Digest opt-in label
digest_opt_in_label.description: The pull request label that fires the digest offer; shipped default explain-change. Empty (default): unset, so to turn the label trigger off, set opt_in_label: "" in a docs/conventions/review-digest YAML file. Those files win over this option.

medium.title: Preferred delivery medium
medium.description: Where /review:explain-change sends a digest page. auto (default): the shipped artifact default, which the publish gate keeps local for a non-public repository or a credential-shaped diff; terminal: no page; file: a local file; artifact: publish anyway; hosted: the shared page host.
